content:
Merit Lists for Admissions in BS Computer Science (Vacant Self-Sustain Seats)
Merit List for Self-Sustain in BS Computer Science
Instructions:
1. Candidates in the merit lists are directed to appear in the admission interviews for self-sustained seats from 1st to 5th November 2026, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM at the Directorate of Admissions UET Mardan.
2. All the candidates must bring the following original documents:
* Migration Certificate (May be provided within one week after the commencement of classes)
* Matric Certificate and DMCs
* FSc Part 1 DMC & Part 2 DMC/Certificate (if available)
* Domicile Certificate
* CNIC/B-Form
* Affidavits (available on Campus)
3. Total fee of Rs. 120,000/- (Including  Admission Fee) must be paid at the time of Admission for
self-sustained seats in BS Computer Science.
4. Hostel Fee for one year 48,920, if the candidate is interested in availing the hostel facility. In addition, the candidate will have to pay 10,000 (refundable) as a security fee.
*Note: Students who do not secure admission in the offered program in will not be included in subsequent merit lists.
